audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phase reasons are shared template text; level 1 claims your Q-poke 'wins the chip war' on a stage the chart itself only rates a coin flip.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is on 8s and silences, Judgment on 9s at rank 1, Courage on 22s at rank 1 — those three timers decide every stage, and none of them were named.
audit.corrected: Phase reasons rewritten around the silence, the spin and Courage's damage reduction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 line said only that 'his ultimate changes the math too', and first item was tied to 'Courage's cooldown' without saying why that matters.
audit.why: Demacian Justice is a 120s true-damage execute, so his level 6 spike is a threshold you must stay above rather than a fight you can win. Your spike is Lich Bane inside the 22s Courage gap.
audit.corrected: phases[4] names the execute and the true damage, phases[5] keys the all-in to Courage being spent, phases[6] states the side-lane limit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Decisive Strike silences, which locks your W, E and R out of the trade, and Demacian Justice is true damage, so magic resist does nothing about it.
audit.why: The kit file flags Decisive Strike silence and Demacian Justice trueDamage plus execute. champ-data/_kits/_missing/akali.json lists both the resistance bypass and Courage absorbing your burst window.
audit.corrected: Silence stated in phases[3].why, dontsFull[2].d and report[5].t; the true-damage execute in phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns; Courage's absorption in phases[1].why and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.why: Courage 22/19.5/17/14.5/12, Decisive Strike a flat 8s, Judgment 9s at rank 1, Demacian Justice 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[1], phases[4], phases[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles — 'Eat his Q silence' was described as diving with no shroud and no energy.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to explain its own title.

edits.before: Shroud his spin — Q-poke, R-execute his low HP. Akali wins the Courage cooldown windows.
edits.after: Shroud his spin — dodge the silence, execute low. Akali wins the Courage cooldown windows.

edits.before: Shroud his spin and execute him. Track Courage before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud his spin and execute him. Courage is 22s at rank 1 — do your killing inside that gap.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Garen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Decisive Strike gives him speed and a silence on 8s, so any walk-up costs you your kit. Farm at Q tip and wait.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Garen's Courage is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites the trade, but Courage (22s) cuts the burst — bait it out first.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Garen must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online: E-mark him, dash the angle, and Shroud his Judgment so the spin turns on empty smoke instead.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Courage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Decisive Strike silences on an 8s cooldown, and silenced you have no W, no E recast and no R.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Garen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, but Demacian Justice (120s) is true damage — magic resist buys nothing, so stay above its threshold.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Courage's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight the moment his Courage has been spent.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Garen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and you kill him in a rotation, but he splitpushes — take the fight to him rather than chasing the map.

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction. Execute when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Courage (22s at rank 1): cuts your burst — bait it, then commit. - Decisive Strike (8s): the silence locks your W, E and R. - Demacian Justice (120s): true damage, so MR does nothing and only your health bar counts.

edits.before: Q Garen at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q him at 550, bait Courage with the kunai, then E-mark and dash in while the spin is on its 9s.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Walking into Decisive Strike — silenced, your W, E and R are all gone for the whole spin.

edits.before: Q Garen at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Vanish as the spin starts and his Judgment grinds on empty smoke for its whole duration.

edits.before: Garen wastes Courage — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Five Point Strike reaches 550 to his 300 — chip from there.

edits.before: That is Garen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His early all-in beats yours until Shroud is online — concede the ground.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Courage cuts the damage you spent everything to land on him.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Silenced, you have no Shroud, no E recast and no ultimate for the whole spin duration.

edits.before: Track Garen's Courage: Damage reduction. Execute when down. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Courage (22s) cuts your burst — bait it first. Decisive Strike silences off W, E and R.

notes: report[8] (Itemization) tells you to rush anti-heal because 'his healing fights your pattern'. Garen's only sustain is Perseverance, an out-of-combat regeneration passive that Grievous Wounds barely touches — that line is wrong for this matchup and should be replaced with the standard core, but I left it alone rather than guess at what the user wants in the slot. Worth a hand pass.
